hook: One shelving unit, every season. This rolling HOMEDANT cart is holding a full seasonal decor rotation right now, string-lit garland, a sunflower wreath, poinsettias, all staged for a client who changes displays by the month, not the year. No fixed shelves to fight with, no separate storage room. Adjustable tiers move in 1.18 inch steps, and the wheels mean the whole thing rolls to wherever the display goes next. Homedant USA Inc has been building boltless steel shelving in our own Korean factory since 1979. Decor rotations, retail backrooms, hospitality staging — the frame doesn't care what's on it. What's the hardest thing you store that doesn't have a "normal" shape?

hook: A university in Korea needed a store room off a teaching building to hold more, without a contractor and without touching the building. The room had to keep working while it was fitted out, on a floor where drilling was not an option. So the frame goes together by hand. HANDiLOCK joints lock the uprights to the beams with no bolts and no tools, which means no drilling, no noise and nothing to lose on the floor. Tier heights move afterwards, in 1.18 inch steps, as what the room holds changes. Homedant USA Inc has been making steel shelving in its own Korean factory since 1979. Rooms like this one are where it ends up. Send me the room dimensions and what has to go in it, and I will come back with a layout and a quote. — Leo Lee What is the longest you have waited on a fit-out that should have taken an afternoon? hashtag #Education hashtag #InstitutionalStorage hashtag #HOMEDANT hashtag #SteelShelving hashtag #StorageSolutions hashtag #KoreanMade hashtag #B2B
